Paragraph: "Look at those chakravaka birds on the riverbank! They are famous for their devotion, never separating even for a moment..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Observing Chakravaka birds known for inseparable companionship.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama points out the legendary loyalty and attachment of the bird pair.
Outcome/Resolution: He draws attention to idealized relationship behavior in nature.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Ananya-Bhakti (Unswerving, undivided devotion exemplified by Chakravaka birds)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Chakravaka birds symbolize unflinching spiritual devotion where two entities function as a single soul.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Projecting ideal relationship standards onto external subjects while mourning one's forced separation.
